welcome_desc: I am your personal AI assistant. My data is stored only on your device.
model_loading_desc: The semantic core enables Aru's long-term memory. This happens only once.
modal_create_db_desc: Your info will be stored locally in your browser. Choose a password:
modal_login_desc: Enter your password to access your local Aru database:
artifact_not_found: Couldn't open the artifact — code not found
confirm_reset_db: Warning! This will permanently delete current database from browser. Continue?
alert_write_permission: Permission required to write to database file.
alert_db_not_found: Error: Password not found in DB.
alert_corrupt_db: Error: File is not an Aru DB or is corrupt.
alert_select_file: Please select a database file first.
alert_no_chat: Create or select a chat first.
alert_max_files: You can attach no more than 5 files at once.
feedback_disclaimer: Aru can make mistakes. Check important info.
canvas_save_prompt: Enter tags separated by comma (e.g. game, report):
no_chat_selected_hint: Write a message to start a new chat with Aru
confirm_delete_chat: Are you sure you want to delete this chat?
sync_error_help: Connection lost. Click to reconnect file.
remote_open_desc: Connect to your Google Drive or WebDAV and open the database file directly from the server.
remote_gdrive_hint: In Google Cloud Console, enable Drive API, create an OAuth Client ID (Web application) and add this site URL to «Authorized JavaScript origins». Paste your Client ID here.
remote_gdrive_step1: In Google Cloud Console, create a project and enable the Google Drive API.
remote_gdrive_step2: In the OAuth consent screen, add the .../auth/drive.file scope (or add a test user).
remote_gdrive_step3: In Credentials, create an OAuth Client ID (type Web application).
remote_gdrive_step4: In the Authorized JavaScript origins field, add the address below:
remote_webdav_hint: Nextcloud, ownCloud, Synology or any WebDAV server works. In a browser (PWA), the server must have CORS enabled (PROPFIND, MKCOL, Depth), or use a reverse proxy (/webdav).
remote_pick_file_link: Pick a file or upload the current database
remote_no_files:
No database files found.
Create a new database with the «Create database» button - it offers cloud storage options.
remote_upload_local: Upload current database as a new file
remote_upload_name_prompt: Name of the new file on the server:
remote_link_take_confirm: Replace the local database with this file?
remote_alert_client_id: Enter the Client ID of your Google Cloud project
remote_alert_webdav_fields: Fill in URL, username and password
remote_alert_local_newer: The local copy is newer than the remote one. Download cancelled to protect your data.
remote_error_setup: Failed to set up cloud storage
remote_error_reauth: Google Drive access expired. Please reconnect Google Drive.
remote_error_webdav_cors: WebDAV request blocked by browser (CORS). The server must allow CORS (PROPFIND, MKCOL, Depth), or use a reverse proxy (/webdav), or set a custom proxy in Network settings.
remote_error_gis_load: Failed to load Google Identity Services library. Check your internet connection or script blockers.
remote_error_gdrive_closed: The Google authorization window was closed.
remote_error_gdrive_token: No access token received from Google.
remote_error_popup_blocked: popup window blocked by the browser
remote_conflict_hint: The database file on the server was changed from another device.
remote_newer_confirm: The remote database copy was changed from another device. Download it now? (Cancel = keep local and upload it)
storage_not_connected_desc: Connect Google Drive or WebDAV to sync the database file between devices automatically. You can change or remove the connection at any time.
storage_locked_desc: The storage profile is encrypted with the master password on this device. Unlock it to enable syncing.
storage_unlock_failed: Failed to unlock storage. It uses the same password as the database.
storage_disconnect_confirm: Disconnect cloud storage? The local database stays on this device; the file on the server is not deleted.
storage_conflict_hint: The database is never locked between devices: the version saved later wins. When in doubt, download the remote copy as a separate file.
storage_check_ok: The remote copy is up to date, no differences.
storage_privacy_note: Keys are encrypted on this device with the master password and are never sent anywhere in plain text. The database file itself contains no keys - you can copy, move and reconnect it freely.
wiz_step4_desc: Choose where the database file will be stored.
wiz_storage_browser_desc: The database stays locally in this browser. No cloud - move it manually by exporting the file.
wiz_storage_file_desc: Aru will remember the chosen .sqlite file and write changes straight to it.
wiz_storage_gdrive_desc: The database will live as a file in the «Aru AI» folder on your Google Drive and sync between devices.
wiz_storage_webdav_desc: The database will live as a file on your WebDAV server (Nextcloud, ownCloud, Yandex Disk, etc.).
prompt_password_desc: Please enter your database password to continue.
confirm_disconnect_db: Current connection will be disconnected. Please choose a database to connect. Continue?
msg_rss_empty: Add RSS feeds in settings to see news.
msg_rss_no_news: No news found in selected feeds.
eula_confirm_btn: I accept the terms of the agreement
settings_rss_urls_hint: Aru will use these feeds to fetch news.
canvas_empty_desc: Documents and apps created by Aru will appear here.
hint_searxng: Find public instances at searx.space or host your own.
login_desc_connected: Your database is connected and synced with disk.
wiz_step1_desc: Let's create your secure Aru database.
wiz_password_hint: This password is used to change databases and access settings. Don't lose it!
wiz_step2_desc: Choose how Aru should communicate with you.
wiz_profile_child_desc: Clear explanations, focus on learning and complete safety.
wiz_profile_teen_desc: Modern tone, balance between study help and personal interests.
wiz_profile_adult_desc: Direct access to all features, professional and helpful tone.
wiz_step3_desc: Set up connection to Aru's intelligence.
wiz_or_warning: Warning! Free models have limits and restrictions!
label_mixed_content_warning: Attention: Browser will block HTTP request from HTTPS site (Mixed Content). Allow 'Insecure content' in site settings.
export_db_hint: It is recommended to download the database after important changes for backup.
empty_memory: Aru has no memory records yet.
import_desc: Select .sqlite file and enter its password
confirm_overwrite_artifact: Artifact with this name already exists. Overwrite?
hint_custom_proxy: Use %URL% as placeholder for the target address.
hint_localhost_priority: Always use direct connection for 127.0.0.1 or local nodes.
hint_custom_api_cors: To use a local model in the browser, you must enable CORS in the server settings (e.g., set OLLAMA_ORIGINS="*").
hint_searxng_cors: Ensure your SearXNG instance sends CORS headers and returns JSON format.
hint_tavily_limit: Cloud search API. The free tier provides 1000 requests.
confirm_overwrite_stale:
⚠️ LOCAL DATA IS NEWER!

Your browser cache has newer messages than the selected file.
Load file and LOSE local changes?

(Cancel = Keep local data and sync it TO file)
alert_corrupt_db_backup: Attention: Database is corrupt. A backup has been created (corrupt_backup) and a new database will be initialized.
private_task_blocked: 🔒 Private mode: I can read and discuss your tasks, but I cannot create, move or delete them here.
transfer_modal_desc: Transfer chats and settings via WebRTC
qr_placeholder: Click the button below to generate QR
camera_placeholder: Allow camera access to scan barcode
transfer_merge_desc: Choose how to apply the received information to your current database.
desc_merge_overwrite: Removes current data and replaces it with new data. Recommended for synchronization.
desc_merge_combine: Adds new chats and facts to your current ones without deleting old ones.
desc_merge_new: Creates a separate database file. Your current data will not change.
transfer_download_done_desc:
Database downloaded successfully.
You can select it when logging into a profile.
transfer_error_incomplete: Transfer incomplete: data was not fully received. Please try again.
settings_security_biometrics_desc: Use Touch ID, Face ID, or your device biometrics (WebAuthn) to quickly access your database and settings without retyping your password.
settings_security_not_supported: Biometric authentication (WebAuthn) is not supported in this browser or is unavailable on this device.
wiz_allow_biometrics: Enable biometric login (Touch ID / Face ID / Fingerprint)
wiz_allow_biometrics_hint: After confirmation, you can instantly unlock the database using your fingerprint or face on this device.
alert_biometrics_not_available: Biometric login is not supported by your device or browser.
settings_security_password_desc: The master password is used to open the database, access settings and encrypt the cloud profile.
settings_security_password_hint: The password cannot be recovered. After changing it you will need to confirm biometrics again, and the cloud profile will be re-encrypted with the new password.
alert_password_mismatch: The new password and confirmation do not match.
alert_password_short: The password is too short - 6 characters minimum.
alert_password_same: The new password is the same as the current one.
alert_password_cloud_locked: Cloud storage is connected but locked. After changing the password it can no longer be unlocked and will have to be connected again. Continue?
alert_password_remote_failed: The password was changed, but the cloud profile could not be re-encrypted. Please reconnect the storage.
alert_password_bio_reset: Biometrics could not be re-registered and has been disabled. Please enable it again.
confirm_delete_folder: Delete the folder? Chats will return to the general list.
chapters_empty: No sections yet — create the first one below.
chapters_pick_hint: Tap a message to anchor this chapter
chapters_delete_section_confirm: Delete this section and all its chapters?
